title: CCTV Footage Reveals Classmate's Bullying in School
summary: A school in Jaipur has released CCTV footage showing the bullying of a student who later took her own life. The incident occurred eight months ago, and the parents of the deceased student have expressed their disappointment with the teachers' lack of assistance. The case highlights concerns about the mental health support available to students in Indian schools.
summary_points: A school in Jaipur has released CCTV footage showing bullying incidents involving a student who later took her own life.
The incident occurred eight months ago, and the parents of the deceased student have expressed their disappointment with the teachers' lack of assistance.
The case highlights concerns about the mental health support available to students in Indian schools.
The school has faced criticism for its handling of the situation, with some questioning why it took so long to release the CCTV footage.
The incident has sparked a wider conversation about bullying and mental health in Indian schools.
